description: We are FireChronos X, a three-member team participating virtually from Bocas del Toro, Panama. We are passionate about using NASA's open data, software, and AI to support environmental research. For the MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots challenge, we aim to explore a transparent way to compare satellite fire detections and communicate historical patterns clearly. We value scientific accuracy, open collaboration, and practical impact for communities in Panama and beyond.
